comments_text: Discovery: Host expression: highly expressed in tissues such as the intestine, liver, spleen, and thymus. Expression is pig strain dependent and increased upon E. coli challenge. Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is most similar (50%) to human DEFB114. GRAVY: -0.53; Mol. Wt.: 5552.485; Mol formula: C236H382N66O74S7; Mol Ex. coeff.: 4845. Activity: Active against E. coli DH5alpha or K88+ (MIC 11.5-23 uM), S.typhimurium ATCC14028 (MIC >512 ug/ml or 92 uM), Streptococcus, S.aureus CICC10384 (MIC >512 ug/ml), and B.subtilis (MIC>512 ug/ml), and fungus P.pastoris X33 (512 ug/ml). In vitro Toxicity: porcine RBC:less than 3.9% hemolysis up to 256 ug/ml: little hemo.lytic. Also, poorly cytotoxic to IPEC-J2 cells below 256 ug/ml. Recombinant production:bacteria:Escherichia coli Origami B (DE3): expressed and tested. Updated 7/2021
reference_text: J Anim Sci Biotechnol. 2019 Jul 19;10:60. doi: 10.1186/s40104-019-0367-0. PubMed
title: Differential expression, molecular cloning, and characterization of porcine beta defensin 114

target_organism_text: E. coli DH5 (MIC = 64 microg/ml), Pathogenic E. coli K88+ (MIC = 128 microg/ml), Salmonella typhimurium ATCC14028 (MIC = >512 microg/ml), Streptococcus (MIC = >512 microg/ml), Staphylococcus aureus CICC10384 (MIC = >512 microg/ml), Bacillus subtilis (MIC = >512 microg/ml), Pichia pastoris X33 (MIC = 512 microg/ml)
title: RPBD-114
